rationale: User: vim Ctrl+Shift+F eats the first visible line for ~1s then redraws; typing duplicates content; close only redraws after another key. A flex sibling search bar shrank term-host (resize_display + 450ms ConPTY). Overlay the last row like wezterm-gui. Reverse hits newest-first and pick a visible match so typing does not jump to scrollback_top. Restore viewport_on_open on close. Do not start 026 or window/ cutover.
